title: The feasibility conjecture for finite abelian groups
statement:
Let $G$ be a finite abelian group. A finite abelian group is called $(|G|-1)$-close when every relevant block-matroid labeling satisfies the corresponding closeness condition.

**Feasibility conjecture.** Every finite abelian group $G$ is $(|G|-1)$-close.

This conjecture concerns the feasibility threshold for congruency-constrained matroid bases. The paper states that it makes progress toward the conjecture; the supplied text gives no resolution evidence. It should not be confused with the earlier, stronger claim involving $D(G)-1$, which the paper says was recently disproved.
source_name: Siyue Liu and Chao Xu, “On the Congruency-Constrained Matroid Base”, arXiv:2311.11737 (2024).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.11737

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of November 2023).
